basis: muxui:decision:0022:amendment:01: retroactive independent review of the current code for the R1.3 families
claimBoundary: findings is not a pass. clear means the reviewer found nothing within the stated lenses, files, tests, and probes; it is not proof of correctness. A fixed resolution means a fix merged in pull request #204 with tests that fail without it; independent reviewers verified those tests on the pull-request branch before merge, and nobody re-reviewed the code after merge. An accepted-unfixed resolution is the decision owner's acceptance, not a fix. Manual and assistive-technology testing remains unmet and deferred to S1.0 (Decision 0022). This is not a hosted review of the original pull request, which had none.
expiry: Retained as historical R1 review evidence for the reviewed commit; a later code change needs a new review rather than an edit. Only the resolution of each finding is updated, by this tool.

findings.summary: Clicking or pressing Enter never selects when nothing is selected yet.
Typed text is thrown away, so tokens can never be added.
Disabled items can be selected and are submitted with the form.
A disabled first tab is selected by default.
Tags announce they can be removed even when they cannot.
Wrong cell content for common column ids.
Missing proof that would have caught H1-H3 and M1-M2.
The TokenField placeholder is always visible and not tied to the textbox.

resolution.reason: Andrew 2026-10-04: a read-only Select stays browsable; no change.

findings.summary: A read-only Select still opens its list.

notChecked: full check:all, remaining browser suites, Storybook axe matrix, packed tarball, and tsc type tests
Menu submenu hover timing and variable-height Virtualizer content
retentionPolicy: Content-addressed Git records retained in default-branch history; reviewer scratch files and agent transcripts are not retained
